description: This source file generates benchmark statistics for various key types and distributions used in hash set probe length analysis, utilizing the Abseil C++ library. It includes benchmarking logic, random data generation, and output formatting for performance comparison.

classes.name: Policy
classes.description: Defines construction, destruction, and element access policies for hash set slots.

classes.name: RandomizedAllocator
classes.description: Provides a pool-based allocator with randomization for hash set elements.

classes.name: DefaultHash
classes.description: Default hash function wrapper for various key types.

classes.name: Table
classes.description: A raw hash set implementation parameterized by key type and policies.

classes.name: LoadSizes
classes.description: Stores minimum and maximum load sizes for hash table testing.

classes.name: Ratios
classes.description: Holds min, average, and max probe length ratios.

classes.name: Result
classes.description: Stores benchmarking results including name, distribution, and ratios.

classes.name: Ptr
classes.description: Incomplete type used for testing hash of pointers with different alignments.

classes.name: PtrIdentity
classes.description: Pointer identity with specific alignment, used for testing.

classes.name: String
classes.description: String data generator with small and large variants.

classes.name: Sequential
classes.description: Sequential data generator for various types.

classes.name: AlmostSequential
classes.description: Data generator that produces mostly sequential data with skips.

classes.name: Random
classes.description: Template for random data generators with various distributions.

methods.name: output
methods.description: Determines the output style based on the benchmarks flag.

methods.name: GetMinMaxLoadSizes
methods.description: Calculates min and max load sizes for hash table testing.

methods.name: CollectMeanProbeLengths
methods.description: Collects probe length statistics for hash table load factors.

methods.name: RunForTypeAndDistribution
methods.description: Runs benchmarks for a specific key type and distribution.

methods.name: RunForType
methods.description: Runs benchmarks for a specific key type across multiple distributions.
